title: Orange orb lands near an open Minot missile silo
summary: James Fox tells of Orange orb lands near an open Minot missile silo, about 1966 or 1968 at Minot Air Force Base, North Dakota, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Minot Air Force Base, North Dakota

tellings.quote: the morning and a UFO came over the base and apparently was like hovering and the guy was screaming like it's it's Landing
